responses.text: Did the colonel send you? I... I was hoping he might have changed his mind...
Got to keep hoping the Colonel will change his mind... maybe send somebody to bring Esteban's body home.
Did you start looking for Esteban? I guess my directions could've been better...
Feels better knowing that Esteban's not out there in the waste. But... he's still gone, you know?
Caps. This whole rotten town wants caps. Nobody does anything just because it's right. {disgusted}
Fine. You want caps? You can have all of Esteban's back pay. NCR owes me, and I don't even want the damn money.

topics.prompt: I can bring his body back, but it'll cost you.

responses.text: Then you're not from the colonel's office? Sorry... I shouldn't have bothered you. {dejected}
I know... I've been crying. Stupid. I'm supposed to be a soldier.
My husband... he's a Ranger, and he... he got murdered by a pack of Fiends. Goddamn savages laid his body out to rot.
The brass won't say it to me straight, but they mean to leave Esteban out there. I can see that plain.
No... I didn't expect nothing so soon. You're doing me a favor - I don't mean to be a pest. {a little disappointed, but trying to mask it}
You said you wanted the caps. If you're thinking I'm not good for the money... please, you've got to take my word.
They put him in a box? With a flag and all? I hope so. He'd have been proud.
You're too good for this rotten town. First kind thing anybody ever did for me and Esteban.
You ever need anything, all you need to do is ask. Thank you so much.
You did what you said you would, and I owe you. Just like I promised, this is Esteban's back pay. Every cap.
Maybe the caps are all that matter to you, but... you still did more for Esteban than his own country did. Thank you.

topics.prompt: I brought his body to an NCR position. He's on his way back to McCarran.

responses.text: You never lost anybody, have you? Not like this. Never had to think about that person you love all alone out there, cooking in the sun like meat...
NCR never leaves a soldier behind. That's what the recruiters told us. Promised us. We believed them.

topics.prompt: If your husband is dead, what does it matter if you get the corpse back?

responses.text: Colonel says he can't spare the men to bring Esteban back home. And the Fiends, they put all kinds of mines and traps around his body. Snipers, too.

topics.prompt: It seems strange the NCR wouldn't do their best to retrieve a fallen comrade.

responses.text: So do I. But I know he won't. Ain't important enough in the scheme of things, you know? Still... thanks for listening. {disappointed that the player can't help}

topics.prompt: Sorry for your loss. I hope the Colonel reconsiders.

responses.text: He was out on patrol. Bunch of drugged-up Fiends attacked them.
Esteban laid down cover fire while the others fell back. One of the men saw him get shot. He didn't die, though, not then.
They tried to go back for him, but there were too many Fiends, and they had to pull out. Damn savages chased them halfway to McCarran.
Not your problem. Right. That's the motto in this town. Rotten people, rotten place. {disgusted}
Mister, I'd about given up hope. But you've got to be careful. I don't want anybody else dying on my account.
Ma'am, I'd about given up hope. But you've got to be careful. I don't want anybody else dying on my account.
Esteban's body is laid out between some buildings, east of the REPCONN headquarters. At least, that's what his squadmates said.
There's an NCR position just north of there. It's on the way. They should be able to tell you what the situation is.
Sorry... I'm not fit for proper conversation, not now.
If you find him... or if you hear any news... I'll be right here.
His best friend, Jackson, tried. Didn't even get permission from his CO, so it could have cost him a lot. But he never came back.

topics.prompt: No one else will help you?

responses.text: {Private Morales:} It was such an incredible thing he did, putting his life on the line like that for my husband. It's not something most people would do.
{Private Morales:} It was such an incredible thing she did, putting her life on the line like that for my husband. It's not something most people would do.
{Private Morales:} Esteban's going home now. I can't tell you what that means to me.
